scope: Host-only verification of the exact 965 manifest target paths and eight retained counterparts; no clone, engine, import, index or commit actions performed by reviewer. Only this review JSON written.
metadata_limitations: Owner and xattr preservation is executor-asserted for all 965 rows; pre-operation owner/xattr values are not included in receipts, so historical preservation cannot be independently proven from those receipts. Corrected executor uses /usr/bin/xattr and restores the captured original xattrs.
Atime preservation is not independently claimed: verification reads may advance atime, and action receipts record no atime values. Exact mtime_ns preservation is independently verified.
Unchanged counterpart means unchanged bytes, fullmode, mtime, inode and device; reads may advance atime.
No global filesystem write audit was performed; reviewed executor destinations are manifest targets, sibling temporary clones and storage recovery receipts.

free_space.causal_scope: Observed volume-wide free-space change only; concurrent activity prevents assigning the entire increase exclusively to this clone batch.
